name: @chbrain/khai-composite-peopling
description: khai composite content, the peopling domain: a place read by the presence in it -- who is crossing because they must, who returns on a rhythm, and who is there for no reason at all -- with the informativeness of presence running inverse to how much the place compelled it.

khai.tagline: Peopling as composite: a place read by the presence in it -- the crossing done because it must be (the errand), the return kept on a rhythm (the round), and the staying done for no reason at all (the loitering) -- wired over the legibility, social-time, and street-life engines, and closing on the discovery that the only presence which reports on a place is the presence the place did not compel.

card.wire: Attaches at Place, on the Shown chapter, over three atoms it declares as dependencies. The root (process_peopling.md) reads a place by the presence in it rather than by what it is made of. The legibility engine supplies the image a place can be held as and moved through, the social-time engine supplies the rhythm it runs on, and the street-life engine supplies the social occupation it hosts. This composite adds no fourth engine; it reads what the three share -- that none of them is in the buildings, and none can be built, only permitted -- and grades the presence they produce by how much of it the place had to compel.
card.issue: Three bridges, ordered by how little the place had to earn. The errand: the crossing that would happen whatever the place were like, since somewhere has to be got to, so it reads as traffic and reports almost nothing. The round: the return kept on a rhythm, half-obliged and half-chosen, which is where strangers become familiars and where a place proves it can be inhabited. The loitering, the twist: the staying done by people with no reason to be there, which is the only presence a place cannot compel and therefore the only one that measures it -- and which is also the presence every efficiency removes, since it is indistinguishable from waste.
card.require: Two altitudes hold the composite. The law: declared once in the project's Instructions Knowledge chapter, linking the root, so the peopling read runs wherever its atoms are cast. The link, advisory: a place may link under Shown the grade of presence it holds, and the audit surfaces where a play stages a public place and never says who is in it or why.
card.enforce: Structure is checked; the read is judged. The kit verifies the law is declared, the composite's own members conform, and every hard link into the atoms resolves through a declared dependency. Whether a production's place genuinely holds the presence the bridge names -- an errand that is only traffic, a round that truly recurs, a loitering that is truly optional -- is semantic, taught and reviewed, never failed by the suite.
card.setup: Install the composite; its atoms arrive as dependencies -- legibility, social-time, street-life -- and their laws with them. Declare the law in the Instructions Knowledge chapter, linking the root. Then read each place for the presence it holds and link it under Shown: the errand where people are passing through on business, the round where they come back on a rhythm, the loitering where they stay for nothing. Keep it the place and not the person, since a persona's bond with a place is the dwelling composite's and a persona among others is midst's; keep it presence and not architecture, since the composite's claim is that the built form only permits; and read the loitering as the instrument rather than the ornament.
